locator: Kantor, chapter 3, table 3, Ps 46:1-2. Hebrew column reconstructed in brackets; word-level rows split at printed separators.
question: Do Hebrew word-initial aleph and ayin have distinct initial Greek vowel letters in these examples?
consequence: Initial epsilon is compatible with both aleph and ayin, and initial ayin is compatible with alpha and epsilon. These word-initial examples do not identify the function of the internal epsilon in Ps 22:25.
exposure: Selected from an inspected publication. No independent blind evaluation. Greek initials are orthographic observations; no isolated consonant pronunciation supplied.
